attributes.title: Level 6

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Did you use the documentation for help with creating right, up, and down facing Projectile sprite images?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What tool can be used to flip an image horizontally?


Solution:

The leftProjectile image asset should be duplicated, then the horizontal flip tool should be used to create a rightProjectile image asset.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What might be different about the Projectile sprite’s image when the Player sprite is facing up or down?


Solution:

upProjectile and downProjectile image assets should be created, using the left and right assets as a guide. The yellow “spray” pixels should be updated to match the up and down directions.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What should be updated in the code so that the Projectile sprite’s image matches the direction that the Player sprite is facing?


Solution:

The images in the createProjectileFromSprite functions should be updated so that the direction in the image asset matches the direction in each condition.
steps.instructions:
Use the paint editor to build out the Projectile images in the sprite pack!


Notice the themed images in the Assets menu for Player, Enemy, Collectible, Goal, and Projectile sprites. 


4 different image assets should be used to show the Projectile sprite facing in different directions.


When the A button is pressed, the Projectile sprite’s image should update based on the direction of the Player sprite.


Use the tools in the paint editor to update the sprite pack!

validationItems.failureText: Try rereading the instructions, then updating the code to include the Projectile sprite image assets.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 6 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating images that show multiple perspectives of the same sprite and themed sprite packs for projects. You’ll be able to take the strategies you learn in this level to create detailed assets in future projects! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 6:

badges.title: Package Deal
badges.description: Create a sprite pack that includes different sprite kinds and different perspectives of those sprites, to be used in a project.

badges.title: Covering All My Bases
badges.description: Create pixel art images that show multiple points of view for a sprite: forward, backward, left, and right.

badges.title: Group by Theme
badges.description: Use a specific color palette and theme to create a sprite pack of different sprite kinds.

badges.title: The Gang’s All Here!
badges.description: Create a sprite pack of original pixel art images that includes Player, Collectible, Goal, Enemy, and Projectile sprites.
